knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Mould must be checked before any work or quote. Mould belongs to the High-risk module, so intake stops and refers it.
Cleaning fabric in place is the carpet and upholstery course. Workshop restoration of the piece is this course.
A recorded reason shows the decision was made on the facts and supports the business's records.

practicalCriteria: Intake questions asked and answers recorded in full
Scope decision recorded with its reason before any quote is issued
Refusal or referral communicated to the client in writing
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
stopWorkCriteria: Suspected mould or contamination found at intake
Work that needs a licence the business does not hold
